title: How to track a package
summary: Enter your tracking number, view real-time status, ETA and notifications.

sections.body: FedEx AI Tracking lets you monitor any shipment in real time from the chat or Tracking History page. This guide walks you through entering a number, reading status updates, and resolving common tracking issues.

steps.title: Open the AI chat or History page
steps.body: From the sidebar, click Chat to ask the assistant, or History to browse past lookups.

steps.title: Enter your tracking number
steps.body: Type a valid FedEx tracking number (12 or 14 digits). Example: 7946 1234 5678. You can paste multiple numbers separated by commas.

steps.title: Review the shipment timeline
steps.body: The assistant returns current status, last scan location, estimated delivery window, and any exceptions.

steps.title: Enable notifications
steps.body: Go to Settings → Notifications and enable shipment alerts to receive updates by email or in-app.

sections.heading: Pro tips
items: Save frequently tracked numbers as favorites in History for one-click access.
Ask the AI « Where is my package? » followed by the number for a natural-language summary.
If status hasn't updated in 24 hours, check Shipment exceptions for delay codes.

faq.question: Invalid tracking number
faq.answer: Verify all digits. FedEx numbers are 12 or 14 characters with no spaces or special characters.

faq.question: No information available
faq.answer: The label may not be scanned yet. Wait 2–4 hours after pickup, then try again.

faq.question: Shipment not found in demo mode
faq.answer: In sandbox environments, use sample numbers provided in the onboarding guide.

title: How to find ETA
summary: Locate estimated delivery dates, time windows and delivery commitments.

sections.body: The Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) shows when your package is expected to reach its destination. FedEx AI aggregates carrier data and presents a clear delivery window in the chat and on the shipment detail card.

steps.title: Track your shipment
steps.body: Enter the tracking number in chat or open it from Tracking History.

steps.title: Locate the ETA block
steps.body: The summary card displays « Estimated delivery » with date and optional time window (e.g. Before 6:00 PM).

steps.title: Check service level
steps.body: Express shipments show tighter windows. Ground services may show « End of day » only.

steps.title: Refresh for updates
steps.body: ETAs recalculate after each scan. Click Refresh or ask « What is the updated ETA? »

sections.heading: Tips
items: Weather or customs delays may push ETA forward — watch for exception alerts.
International shipments include customs clearance in the estimate.
Subscribe to notifications to get ETA change alerts automatically.

faq.question: Why did my ETA change?
faq.answer: Operational delays, weather, or rerouting can adjust the delivery date after a new scan.

faq.question: Can I get a guaranteed time?
faq.answer: Only specific FedEx services include time-definite delivery. Check your service type on the label.

title: Shipment exceptions
summary: Understand delay codes, holds, customs issues and how to resolve them.

sections.body: An exception means something interrupted the normal delivery flow — address problems, customs holds, weather, or missed delivery attempts. FedEx AI highlights exceptions in red on the timeline and suggests next steps.

sections.heading: What to do when you see an exception

steps.title: Read the exception code
steps.body: Each event includes a short description (e.g. « Delivery attempted — recipient not available »).

steps.title: Follow recommended actions
steps.body: The AI assistant may suggest contacting the recipient, updating the address, or scheduling redelivery.

steps.title: Contact support if needed
steps.body: For customs or damaged-package exceptions, open a support ticket with the tracking number attached.

steps.title: Monitor the timeline
steps.body: Exceptions often resolve within 24–48 hours after corrective action.

sections.heading: Prevention tips
items: Ensure the delivery address includes apartment or suite numbers.
For international shipments, provide accurate customs documentation upfront.
Use delivery instructions in Settings for gate codes or safe-drop preferences.

faq.question: Customs delay
faq.answer: Additional documentation may be required. Check email for FedEx customs notifications.

faq.question: Weather delay
faq.answer: No action needed — delivery resumes when conditions improve.

faq.question: Returned to sender
faq.answer: Contact support immediately if the package was returned without your request.

title: Delivery issues
summary: Resolve missed deliveries, wrong addresses, damaged packages and proof requests.

sections.body: Delivery issues range from missed attempts to incorrect addresses. This guide covers diagnosis, self-service fixes, and when to escalate to FedEx support.

steps.title: Confirm delivery status
steps.body: Check if the package shows « Delivered », « Out for delivery », or « Exception ».

steps.title: Verify the address
steps.body: Compare the label address with the intended destination. Request an address correction before the next attempt.

steps.title: Schedule redelivery
steps.body: For missed deliveries, use FedEx Delivery Manager or ask the AI to guide you through redelivery options.

steps.title: File a claim if needed
steps.body: For lost or damaged items, gather photos and open a support ticket within 21 days of delivery date.

sections.heading: Best practices
items: Require signature for high-value shipments.
Add delivery instructions for apartment complexes.
Download proof of delivery immediately after confirmation.

faq.question: Package marked delivered but not received
faq.answer: Check with neighbors and building staff. If still missing, contact support within 48 hours.

faq.question: Can I change the delivery address?
faq.answer: Yes, before the final delivery attempt via Delivery Manager or support ticket.

title: Proof of delivery
summary: Access, download and share POD documents and delivery signatures.

sections.body: Proof of Delivery (POD) confirms that a shipment was delivered, including date, time, and recipient signature when available. Access POD from Documents or directly from the shipment detail view.

steps.title: Navigate to Documents
steps.body: Open My Documents from the sidebar, or ask the AI « Show proof of delivery for [tracking number] ».

steps.title: Select the shipment
steps.body: Filter by tracking number or delivery date to locate the record.

steps.title: Download PDF
steps.body: Click « Download POD » to save the signed delivery confirmation.

steps.title: Share securely
steps.body: Use the share link option for time-limited access to external stakeholders.

sections.heading: Tips
items: POD is available within minutes after delivery confirmation.
Archive important POD files monthly for compliance audits.
In demo mode, sample POD PDFs are generated for testing.

faq.question: POD not available yet
faq.answer: Wait until status shows « Delivered ». Signature capture may take up to 30 minutes to process.

faq.question: Missing signature on POD
faq.answer: Some deliveries are release-authorization only. Contact support for a delivery photo if available.

title: Export Excel
summary: Export tracking history and shipment data to Excel spreadsheets.

sections.body: Export your tracking history to Excel for reporting, billing reconciliation, and team sharing. Exports include tracking numbers, statuses, ETAs, and delivery dates.

steps.title: Open Tracking History
steps.body: Go to History from the sidebar to view all tracked shipments.

steps.title: Apply filters
steps.body: Filter by date range, status, or search term to narrow the export.

steps.title: Click Export Excel
steps.body: The file downloads as .xlsx with formatted columns and headers.

steps.title: Alternative: ask the AI
steps.body: Type « Export my tracking history to Excel » in chat for a guided export.

sections.heading: Tips
items: Daily export quotas may apply depending on your plan.
Schedule recurring exports via Settings → Reports (Enterprise).
Large exports (>1000 rows) are emailed as a download link.

faq.question: Export limit reached
faq.answer: Wait until the next day or upgrade your plan for higher quotas.

faq.question: Missing columns
faq.answer: Customize export fields in Settings → Documents → Export preferences.

title: Download reports
summary: Generate and download PDF summaries, analytics reports and audit logs.

sections.body: FedEx AI Tracking generates PDF reports for individual shipments, monthly summaries, and compliance audits. Reports are available from Documents and the admin dashboard.

steps.title: Open Documents → Reports
steps.body: Browse available report templates: Shipment Summary, Monthly Activity, POD Bundle.

steps.title: Configure parameters
steps.body: Select date range, tracking numbers, or account scope.

steps.title: Generate and download
steps.body: Click Generate. PDFs under 10 MB download instantly; larger files are sent by email.

steps.title: Schedule recurring reports
steps.body: Enterprise users can schedule weekly or monthly auto-delivery to email.

sections.heading: Tips
items: Use Monthly Activity reports for executive dashboards.
POD Bundle combines all delivery proofs for a date range.
Reports include your organization logo when configured in Settings.

faq.question: Report generation failed
faq.answer: Reduce the date range or number of shipments and retry.

faq.question: Can I export to CSV?
faq.answer: Use Export Excel for spreadsheet format; PDF reports are optimized for printing.

title: Archive history
summary: Archive, restore and manage long-term tracking history records.

sections.body: Archiving moves older tracking records out of the active view while keeping them searchable and exportable. This keeps your workspace clean without losing data.

steps.title: Open Tracking History
steps.body: Select one or more shipments using the checkboxes.

steps.title: Click Archive
steps.body: Archived items move to the Archive tab and no longer appear in the default list.

steps.title: Access archived records
steps.body: Switch to the Archive tab or search with « include:archived » in the filter bar.

steps.title: Restore if needed
steps.body: Select archived items and click Restore to return them to active history.

sections.heading: Tips
items: Auto-archive rules can be configured in Settings → History (90/180/365 days).
Archived records remain exportable to Excel and PDF.
Enterprise retention policies may override manual archive settings.

faq.question: Are archived records deleted?
faq.answer: No. Archive is a organizational feature only. Data is retained per your plan's retention policy.

faq.question: Bulk archive limit
faq.answer: You can archive up to 500 shipments at once. For larger batches, use auto-archive rules.
